title: MRR EvidenceMatrix
description: docs/spec/08_RESEARCH_METHOD_KERNEL.md (status ACCEPTED, 2026-07-21) section 3's object table ('EvidenceMatrix | structured evidence: one row per source x claim-relevant finding, each row anchored to a resolvable SourceRecord/EvidenceAnchor with verification status and source family | draft -> active -> frozen -> superseded'). Fourth of the six task-packets/K1-T01.yaml entities. MRR-MTH-015: every row MUST anchor a resolvable source with a verification status and a source family; unverifiable rows are marked, never dropped. 'rows' carries NO minimum length (deliberately, unlike ConceptCharter.entries) — MRR-MTH-011: 'insufficient_evidence outcomes ... MUST NOT be silently omitted from any claim landscape' means a matrix that legitimately found zero usable sources must remain constructible, not rejected as degenerate. 'verification_status' is this task's own minimal, three-value local vocabulary (not a specification-given one, mirroring evidence-anchor.schema.json's own recomputation_status disclosure) — accepted per task-packets/K1-T01.yaml reviewer_resolution.

row_id.description: Stable handle for this row, unique within one EvidenceMatrix revision (enforced by a Pydantic model_validator).

evidence_anchor_id.description: A row may exist before any EvidenceAnchor resolves it.

source_family_id.description: Mirrors SourceRecord.source_family_id's own identical optionality — SourceFamily machinery may not have run yet.

unverifiable_reason.description: MRR-MTH-015: required non-null, non-empty exactly when verification_status == 'unverifiable' — 'unverifiable rows are marked, never dropped'.

claim_relevant_finding.description: The actual finding text this row records.

extraction.description: Free-form, keyed by the governing MethodProtocol's own extraction_fields names — not cross-validated against them here (service-level, deferred).

sensitivityAnalysisResult.description: MRR-MTH-018 (task-packets/K1-T03b.yaml): 'results under each variation MUST be reported'. One entry per (variation_entry_id, applies_to_analysis) pair the executor computed for a declared sensitivity variation.

variation_entry_id.description: MRR-MTH-018: the ConceptCharterEntry.entry_id this result executes — one of the governing MethodProtocol's own declared sensitivity_variations values. Not cross-validated against a real ConceptCharter here (service-level, deferred, mirrors sensitivity_variations' own identical disclosed limitation).

applies_to_analysis.description: The same applies_to_analysis key the base run's own analysis used — matches_base_outcome compares this variation's outcome against the base run's outcome for the identical key.

outcome.description: The SAME four-value outcome vocabulary the executor's own base classification uses.

decision_rationale.description: Required non-null exactly when outcome == 'insufficient_evidence' — mirrors evidenceMatrixRow.unverifiable_reason's own identical co-occurrence pattern.

matches_base_outcome.description: Whether this variation's own outcome for applies_to_analysis equals the base run's own outcome for the same key — MTH-018's 'results under each variation MUST be reported' is chiefly for this comparison.

protocol_id.description: The locked MethodProtocol this matrix is assembled under. A plain body field, never an edge; not validated to resolve to a locked MethodProtocol here (service-level, deferred).

question_id.description: The QuestionModel this matrix's evidence addresses. A plain body field, never an edge; not validated to resolve to an accepted QuestionModel here (service-level, deferred).

rows.description: MRR-MTH-011: no minimum length — a zero-row matrix (legitimately found no usable sources) is schema-valid.

status.description: Lifecycle status (spec 08 section 3's table: draft -> active -> frozen -> superseded).

sensitivity_analysis_results.description: MRR-MTH-018 (task-packets/K1-T03b.yaml): 'results under each variation MUST be reported' — OPTIONAL, NULLABLE. Absent/null on every EvidenceMatrix that declares no sensitivity_variations (every existing example/fixture). uniqueItems catches a fully-duplicated entry at the schema level (mirrors concept-charter.schema.json's own entries); the stronger same-(variation_entry_id, applies_to_analysis)-different-content case is caught only by the Pydantic model_validator, since JSON Schema has no per-subfield uniqueness construct across two keys.
